hook.text: All four pieces are the saxophonist's own compositions, and the CD reissue adds an alternate take of one of them.

facts.label: Recorded
facts.value: 21 May 1965, Van Gelder Studio, Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey

facts.label: Players
facts.value: Sam Rivers (tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone, flute), Freddie Hubbard (trumpet), Herbie Hancock (piano), Ron Carter (bass), Joe Chambers (drums)

sentences.text: The album was recorded on 21 May 1965 at Van Gelder Studio in Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey.
Rivers played tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone and flute.
Freddie Hubbard played trumpet, Herbie Hancock the piano, Ron Carter the bass and Joe Chambers the drums.

listen_for.text: The CD reissue also has a second take of this one, listed as a bonus.
